g.title: Request once, receive training costs in every fold
The cross-validator slices clv with X and y before calling each cloned model's fit.
Full data: rows of X and y, with one clv value per row
cross_val_score(model, X, y, params={'clv': clv}, cv=3)
fit on C, D, E, F
fit on A, B, E, F
fit on A, B, C, D
With metadata routing enabled, each fit receives only its training rows and matching costs.
